description: Unified Vue 3 + HTML test knowledge navigator — 12 source skills consolidated into a single, topic-routed reference.

topics.label: Vitest setup
topics.single_responsibility: Vitest as the canonical runner, vite.config.js test block, environment selection (happy-dom / jsdom), @vue/test-utils mounting, package.json scripts, tsconfig globals, @testing-library/vue integration, fake timers, module mocking.

topics.label: Runner choice (node vs browser)
topics.single_responsibility: Vitest with happy-dom / jsdom for logic-focused component tests (fast, simulated DOM), Vitest Browser Mode for style-dependent tests (real CSS rendering, computed styles, native DOM events like focus / drag / resize, cookies, cross-browser behavior).

topics.label: E2E with Playwright
topics.single_responsibility: Vue 3 E2E testing with Playwright — npm init playwright@latest init, Vue dev server integration (webServer config in playwright.config.ts), multi-browser projects (Chromium / WebKit / Firefox), locator strategies that match component-test patterns (getByRole / getByTestId), CI parallel execution, trace viewer and screenshot debugging.

topics.label: Cross-cutting HTML test fixture
topics.single_responsibility: Scaffold self-contained test pages (no localhost, no external API, file:// URLs work), generate assertions across 5 types (DOM presence, text content, CSS properties, event handling, visual regression), capture and diff screenshots against baselines pixel-by-pixel (pass < 1% / warning 1-3% / fail > 3%), browser-compat contracts (Chrome 90+, Firefox 90+, Safari 15+, Edge 90+; required: CSS custom properties, ES modules, web components, CSS grid; supported: prefers-reduced-motion).
triggers: chrome firefox safari edge minimum version

topics.label: Async test reactivity
topics.single_responsibility: Vue 3 async test reactivity — await trigger() / await setValue(), await nextTick() for programmatic reactive state changes, await flushPromises() for external async (API calls, timers, MSW), avoiding chained nextTick anti-pattern, combining methods for form-submit-and-assert flows.

topics.label: Async component (defineAsyncComponent)
topics.single_responsibility: Vue 3 defineAsyncComponent testing — async/await in the test function, await flushPromises() after mounting to ensure the async component has loaded before assertions, testing the loading state by asserting before flushPromises, testing the error state via rejected promises in the loader / errorComponent, await on trigger() since it returns a Promise, stubbing the loader to resolve/reject deterministically.

topics.label: Suspense (async setup)
topics.single_responsibility: Vue 3 Suspense testing — wrap async-setup components (<script setup> with top-level await or async setup()) in <Suspense> before mounting, await flushPromises() to wait for the async setup to resolve, access the inner component via findComponent() after resolution, fallback slot for loading state, error boundary for rejected async setup, mountSuspense helper pattern.

topics.label: Composable testing (withSetup)
topics.single_responsibility: Vue 3 composable testing — direct testing for simple composables (refs/computed only), host-component wrapper (withSetup helper) for composables using lifecycle hooks (onMounted / onUnmounted) or dependency injection (inject), app.provide() to mock injected dependencies, unmounting the test app after each test for cleanup, defineComponent + setup host pattern.

topics.label: Pinia testing
topics.single_responsibility: Vue 3 Pinia testing — createTestingPinia from @pinia/testing for component tests via global.plugins, setActivePinia(createPinia()) in beforeEach for store unit tests, createSpy: vi.fn when not using Vitest globals, stubActions: false when real action execution is needed, initializing the store inside each test for fresh state, mocking getters and state via store.$patch / store.$state.

topics.label: Teleport testing
topics.single_responsibility: Vue 3 Teleport testing — wrapper.html() scopes to the component root and cannot find teleported content; stub Teleport in unit tests to keep content in the component tree; use document.body queries for integration tests with real Teleport; consider getComponent() instead of DOM queries for teleported children; attachTo: document.body mount option so the teleported target exists.

topics.label: Black-box component testing
topics.single_responsibility: Vue 3 component black-box testing — test the public API (props, events, slots) not implementation details; query by role / text / testid; simulate user interactions rather than calling internal methods; assert on rendered output, emitted events, visible state changes; avoid wrapper.vm.privateMethod and wrapper.vm.count assertions; use data-testid for elements without semantic meaning.

topics.label: Snapshot anti-pattern
topics.single_responsibility: Vue 3 snapshot anti-pattern — snapshot-only tests verify HTML structure but not functionality; they lead to false confidence, tests that pass on broken code (snapshot converges on the snapshot, not the spec), and brittle tests that break on any refactor. Use snapshots sparingly for regression detection on stable UI, always pair with behavioral assertions, keep snapshots small and focused (avoid full-component snapshots), review diffs carefully before --update, consider inline snapshots for small critical structures.
